actor.name: OpenAI Frontier
actor.description: Enterprise platform to build and manage 'AI coworkers', incl. agents built elsewhere; onboarding and feedback loop; limited availability.

note: Feedback-loop framing for agents; enterprise, not GA. Traction: Named customers HP, Oracle, State Farm, Uber (https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/05/openai-launches-a-way-for-enterprises-to-build-and-manage-ai-agents/). Licence: Proprietary; pricing undisclosed.
